{{Quote|Raawrr!|Chewbacca, spotting the planet from the cockpit of the ''Millennium Falcon''|<ref name="WOFW" />}}
There existed a '''green planet''' in the vicinity of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|heroes]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were [[Ambush on the green planet|ambushed]] by the enemy [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on that planet. Although outnumbered, the Rebels were saved at the eleventh hour by a contingent of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warriors who had made their home on the planet.

==Description==
[[File:WOFTW_landing.png|thumb|left|The ''Millennium Falcon'' landing on the green planet's surface]]
A [[Color/Legends|green]] terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was located somewhere in the vicinity of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="WOFW" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="OR" /> Its surface was at least partly covered with [[Tree/Legends|forests]] and [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]]. Between the wooded areas, there existed clearings wide enough for a medium-sized [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to land with ease. [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] could breath the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] unassisted,<ref name="WOFW" /> which hinted at a mixture of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], [[Nitrogen/Legends|nitrogen]] and other gases.<ref name="POG1">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref> There were two celestial bodies visible from the planet's surface in full daylight.<ref name="WOFW" />

==History==
{{Quote|I think we're safe for now. There's no one around for miles.|Han Solo|<ref name="WOFW" />}}
[[File:WOFTW_quarter_allowed.png|thumb|The Wookiees of the green planet taking prisoners]]
At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that opposed the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the green planet was the stage of a [[Ambush on the green planet|minor attack]] that involved the Rebel [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|heroes]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. The two were forced to make a rough landing there with their starship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], while trying to escape Imperial troops who had discovered their presence in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], Tatooine. While the planet appeared to be uninhabited, Solo soon realized there was Imperial presence when a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] and [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] came out of the wood and ambushed the ''Falcon''. However, the planet was also home to a population of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. Chewbacca, as a member of their [[Species/Legends|species]], successfully sneaked past the Imperial ambush and mobilized his fellow Wookiees to fend off the Empire.<ref name="WOFW" />

==Inhabitants==
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Galactic Civil War, a contingent of more than thirty Wookiee warriors had established their domicile on the green planet.<ref name="WOFW" />
